hooks.text: Signalmen hid a passenger train on the main line and forgot.
Over two hundred people died in Britain's worst ever rail crash.
A troop train slammed into stationary wreckage at eighty miles per hour.

title: Britain's Worst Rail Disaster Started With a Shift Change ⚠️
description: On May 22, 1915, signalmen forgot a stationary train on the main line at Quintinshill, triggering a catastrophic multi-train collision and fire.
